source.title: Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md if there is no Claude.md
source.author: datadrivenangel

excerpt.zh: AGENTS.md现可作为Claude Code的项目说明文件，在没有CLAUDE.md时自动读取，但云端平台支持仍有限。
excerpt.en: AGENTS.md is now a fallback project-instructions file for Claude Code when CLAUDE.md is absent, with limited platform support.

text.zh: AGENTS.md成为Claude Code的备用项目说明文件
text.en: AGENTS.md Becomes a Fallback for Claude Code Project Instructions

text.zh: AGENTS.md现在获得Claude Code支持：如果项目中没有CLAUDE.md，Claude Code会改为读取AGENTS.md。该变化出现在2.1.277版本更新中，为采用通用代理说明文件的代码仓库减少了一项额外配置。
text.en: AGENTS.md is now supported by Claude Code: when a project has no CLAUDE.md, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md instead. The change appears in the 2.1.277 release and reduces extra configuration for repositories that already use the broader agent-instructions convention.

text.zh: 这项兼容性更新意味着什么
项目维护者可以继续使用AGENTS.md记录编码约定、工作流程或其他供代理遵循的项目级信息，而无需仅为Claude Code复制一份同内容的CLAUDE.md。它仍然是“备用”关系：如果CLAUDE.md存在，更新说明指向的是在没有该文件时读取AGENTS.md，并未表示两个文件会合并或同时生效。
text.en: Maintainers can keep project-level coding conventions, workflows, and other agent guidance in AGENTS.md without creating a duplicate CLAUDE.md solely for Claude Code. The relationship is explicitly a fallback: the release note says AGENTS.md is read when CLAUDE.md is missing, but does not say that the two files are merged or applied together.

text.zh: 平台范围仍是关键限制
text.en: Platform Availability Remains the Key Limitation

text.zh: 这项功能目前尚未提供给 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry。更新说明也没有进一步交代文件查找的完整层级、冲突处理方式，或不同运行环境下的优先级，因此团队在迁移既有项目说明前，仍应以实际版本和目标部署环境验证行为。此次版本还包含大量稳定性与错误处理修复，但这些修复不应被解读为扩大了AGENTS.md支持范围。
text.en: The feature is not yet available on Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry. The changelog also does not specify the full file-discovery hierarchy, conflict behavior, or priority rules across environments. Teams should therefore verify the behavior against their installed version and deployment target before changing established project instructions. The release includes many stability and error-handling fixes, but those fixes should not be read as expanding AGENTS.md availability.
